decision: Preserve the complete REAL_TO_SIM 2/2 pass and SIM_TO_REAL 1/2 partial without promotion. Stroke length is rejected as sufficient because d7-to-e7 remains below progress only at the lateral-plus 3 mm endpoint. Freeze one bounded path-shape mechanism across the complete four-family set: a two-lane precontact push using exactly the already-frozen minus 3 mm and plus 3 mm lateral reset endpoints, with the same 66 mm longitudinal stroke in each lane and a clearance retreat between lanes. Keep wrist, contact height, jaw target, physics, reset layout, plant paths, gates, and false physical authority unchanged. No dynamic replay is authorized until all four two-lane actions pass the static gates and are frozen exactly.
